request: Should we use JWT or session cookies for the MCP hub auth?
response: Decision: use short-lived bearer tokens (JWT) with server-side revocation list. Session cookies rejected because stdio and multi-client agents cannot share cookie jars reliably. Documented in ADR-012.

request: better-sqlite3 throws SQLITE_BUSY under concurrent observe calls
response: Root cause: default busy_timeout was 0. Fix: set pragma busy_timeout=5000 and serialize writes through a single queue. Confirmed under 20 parallel processInteraction calls.

request: What did we learn from the double-save incident last week?
response: Learning: client-side dedup is not enough under retries after timeout. Always send Idempotency-Key and treat UNKNOWN as retry-same-key, never mint a new key.
Pattern: call brain_observe from SessionEnd hook and after verified fixes only. Do not observe every turn — noise destroys retrieval quality.
